builds.hardware_validated: Loaded and played on an MS-70CDR+ (fw 1.20): both v0.21 blank files install, show their parameters and four model labels, and match their captures as the v0.20 files did; removed cleanly. v0.21 (2026-10-15) is the v0.20 build (validated on MS-70CDR+ fw 1.20, 2026-10-07) with only the version field, the CRC and the effect id rewritten (index 22 to index 21 variant 1, the variant rule); the code and every other byte are unchanged. The v0.20 validation: at the first-loads sitting of 2026-10-07 12:03-13:32, one article (four captures) spliced from the v0.20 bytes, installed twice, read back byte-identical, loaded and answering; the Model knob switches among the captures and takes no position past the last; the rig's per-position ESR 0.0158 / 0.0169 / 0.097 / 0.0045 against a limit of 0.142, the wrong-capture control failing at 0.451 as it must; the first run of the plain engine with a Model knob on a pedal; Thomas heard it: 'it sounds good, it sounds the same'. NOT measured: the declared load 134.5; full speed at every Model position.

Loaded and played on an MS-50G+ (fw 1.40): both v0.21 blank files install, show their parameters and four model labels, and match their captures; removed cleanly. v0.21 (2026-10-15) is the v0.20 build (validated on MS-50G+ fw 1.40, 2026-10-07) with only the version field, the CRC and the effect id rewritten (index 22 to index 21 variant 1, the variant rule); the code and every other byte are unchanged. The v0.20 validation: at part 2 of the first-loads sitting, 2026-10-07 13:46-14:13, one article (four captures) spliced from the v0.20 bytes, installed, read back byte-identical, loaded by a one-effect patch and answering; the pedal reports the four capture names and takes no Model position past the last; VOL ACKed; the pedal back in its state of record. No sound was checked on this model (one mono input, no sound-card route): the load counts by the pedal's answers and Thomas's reading of the screen.
